before.title: Cats Cute Miner
before.short: Lead a cat mining crew, build factories, and collect cards and equipment.
before.full:
Put your cat crew to work in an underground mining adventure. Your cats dig through rocks, fill their bags, and bring the coins back to base. Spend the coins they deliver to improve the whole team.

BUILD YOUR MINING CREW
Upgrade mining power, movement, carrying capacity, unloading speed, and the value of your haul. Tap rocks to lend your cats a helping paw.

EXPLORE 144 MINES
Open gates and uncover branching tunnels as you work through the campaign. Clear each mine and move on to the next challenge.

RUN YOUR CAT FACTORIES
Uncover factories in the mines, deliver their goods to the warehouse, and sell your stock at the market. Collect factory cards to improve production.

COLLECT 62 CARDS AND UPGRADE YOUR GEAR
Equip pickaxes, hats, backpacks, and boots. Collect cards and improve their bonuses. Equipment and card progress carry into the next mine, while local mine upgrades start fresh.

RETURN TO YOUR CATS
Your saved crew can make progress while you are away. Return, collect the results, and decide what to upgrade next.

Optional in-app purchases are available. Randomized card chests have their chances shown in the game.
